evals.prompt: ship forge: a confirmed empty-export bug has a reproducible unit test and the user authorizes complete local delivery. Take it from intake through integration, but do not push.
evals.expected_output: Loads protocol, admission, and delivery; requires Curator acceptance and independent Gatekeeper approval before ready; drives Coordinator, Fixer, and Verifier through local commits and integration without pushing or adding another approval role.
expectations: Requires Curator acceptance and Gatekeeper approval before Coordinator claims the item.
Assigns implementation to Fixer and independent candidate review to Verifier.
Ends at local integration of all changed repositories without push, deployment, release, or external reply.

evals.prompt: Review commit 9f31c2a and its direct effects. This is read-only: check the implementation, tests, and design, and make it possible to resume after an interruption.
evals.expected_output: Loads protocol and inspector, binds the exact candidate, uses the fixed commit checkpoint and a per-round report, separates confirmed findings from speculation, and does not automatically fix or create a Work Item.
expectations: Binds the review to the exact commit and its real parent or base.
Uses test/runs/code-review/commit.md and a per-round report for recovery.
Separates confirmed findings from unconfirmed candidates and does not automatically fix or transfer them.

evals.prompt: An external user says the workspace occasionally freezes when switching tabs, but there are no logs or reproduction steps yet. Transfer this through the normal admission flow.
evals.expected_output: Uses Curator reception and Gatekeeper fact check, preserves the external source and uncertainty, seeks the smallest decisive evidence, and does not mark a confirmed Bug ready or dispatch implementation prematurely.
expectations: Returns needs evidence rather than approved or ready.
Requests a bounded reproduction or timestamped sanitized diagnostic evidence.
Does not dispatch implementation or claim a confirmed root cause.
